title: Typed realization and boundary data for integral constant towers
statement: With specified derived-category models, realize an ordinary integer-to-shifted-units sheaf arrow by the exact constant-tower functor. Record a class and this defining realization. Name the morphism types and the canonical integer and shifted units boundary comparisons. The actual line-bundle class supplies a realization record by its defining formula.

proof.text: All objects and morphisms are explicit. normalizedConstantArrow is mapSingleArrow of the constant functor. IntegralConstantClass records the ordinary arrow, the tower arrow, and their equality. The integer and units morphism types are the original derived comparison types. The comparisons are the canonical single comparison and its shifted version. For a line bundle, choose lineBundleEtaleClass and lineBundleClass; their defining formulas give the realization equality by reflexivity.

def normalizedConstantArrow (T : Scheme.{u})
    [hDiag : HasDerivedCategory.{u + 1} (DiagonalAb T)]
    [hAb : HasDerivedCategory.{u + 2} (Ab T)]
    (h : (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (DiagonalAb T) 0).obj
      ((constantSheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology T) AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}).obj
        (AddCommGrpCat.of (ULift.{u + 1} ℤ))) ⟶
      ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (DiagonalAb T) 0).obj
        (Scheme.proEtaleUnitsSheaf T))⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧) :
    (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (Ab T) 0).obj (integers T) ⟶
      ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (Ab T) 0).obj (units T))⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧
